MVCTTR.description: Moving Load Analysis Control Data - Transverse (MVCTTR). Single-instance record (key 1); INFL_GEN_POINT selects the influence-line generation method and thereby which spacing field applies (NUM_UNIT_LOAD when 0, DISTANCE otherwise).

LOAD_POINT_SEL.description: Load Point Selection. Integer code selecting the load-point set used for the transverse moving-load analysis.

INFL_GEN_POINT.description: Influence line generation method. 0 = generate by number of unit loads per line element (uses NUM_UNIT_LOAD); non-zero = generate by fixed spacing distance (uses DISTANCE).

NUM_UNIT_LOAD.description: [INFL_GEN_POINT=0] Number of unit loads per line element used to generate the influence line.

DISTANCE.description: [INFL_GEN_POINT!=0] Distance between load points (spacing) used to generate the influence line.

ANALYSIS_RESULT.description: Analysis Results Type. Integer code selecting the category of results produced by the transverse moving-load analysis.
